title: 第7章 老天开眼第8章 昔日弟子
content_zh:
第七章 老天开眼
迫于父亲的威胁，戚震只得老老实实地继续练习跨栏，最终成为后来中国跨栏的第一人，后来在回忆录还感谢父亲当时的做法。可是深爱中国足球的高军知道这件事后，却对此感到十分心寒，父亲为儿子的前途考虑无可厚非，但一个中国足坛的重要人物，却也如此固执地反对儿子进入这一行，中国足球哪儿还有希望？
也正因为知道让一个顶尖的跨栏运动员转行来踢足球是多么地不易，因此高军对眼前这个自己送上门来的小子格外珍视，尤其谢文俊还与戚震的情况不太一样，他现在才刚满10岁，可塑性无疑要大得多，也因此更值得高军为他量身定做一整套未来的职业规划，尽管其中的大部分暂时还不能告诉他本人......
考虑到谢文俊现在的技术底子还很薄弱，高军并没有马上就设法让他改变位置，以免初上前场却表现不佳而愈发对足球失去兴趣。而是在每天训练结束后，专门陪他进行一对一与射门练习，先由谢文俊担任守门员、高军带球进攻，然后再倒过来，这样慢慢培养谢文俊最基本的进攻能力，而且这对高军进一步习惯这具新身体、尽快恢复巅峰期的球技也有帮助。
此外，高军还特别给谢文俊开了小灶，将过人、摆脱、接球、传球、传中、射门的各种简单而实用的技巧教给了谢文俊，而且值得一提的是，这些动作都经高军特别筛选过，确保不会受到记忆中谢文俊的先天性脊柱骨裂影响，而且也不会诱发与之有关的伤病。
但是令高军没有想到的是，不久之后崇明基地的一次全面体检中谢文俊居然没被检查出任何问题，记忆里的腰椎骨裂并未出现在这个时空的谢文俊身上，高军得知后自然更加欣喜，不禁感叹老天爷开眼，从此愈发认真细致地给谢文俊不断开小灶，令其成长速度越来越快......
其实脊椎骨裂在中国是一种很常见的先天缺陷，比例高达好几分之一，只是除了极少数情况严重的例子，影响并不是很大，只要不是从事骨裂部位会频繁受到猛烈冲击的工作就行。而其最主要的成因，则是母亲受孕时及怀孕初期体内叶酸缺乏（发现怀孕后再补充没用，必须在受孕时就不缺叶酸。）导致胎儿神经管发育不全，而且也不是一定会发生，只有几分之一的概率而已（注1），因此在这个时空发生一些微小的变化而令谢文俊免于这一先天疾患的困扰其实也没什么好惊奇的。
没有这个先天缺陷后，高军几乎可以肯定，如果谢文俊还像历史上那样去学跨栏，超过刘翔的可能性是非常大的。但在热爱足球的高军眼中，中国多一个跨栏王的价值远不如中国多一个世界级的球星，而即使对于谢文俊来说也是如此，由于足球运到的巨大影响力，若他真能成为世界级的大球星，无论是名声还是利益都不会比跨栏王差，何况刘翔赚得盆满钵满很大程度上是占了“第一个”的光，谢文俊学跨栏的话就算在成绩上超过他，也不可能获得那么大的名利了。因此不管怎么样，高军还是坚持要将谢文俊培养成一个出色的球员，而改踢进攻位置后谢文俊对于足球的兴趣也迅速得到了恢复，对一个小球员来说，再没什么比兴趣更能促使他飞速进步了......
话说当年高洪虽然在比赛中很少过人，但那只是因为他速度太慢，过了人也没有太大意义，但如果只论过人技术的话，球商极高而且自小刻苦的高洪至少在国内也算得上是二流水平了，他的远射与任意球能力也是如此，只有传中和各种防守技术他没怎么练过......
在训练中，高军发现谢文俊学习各种技巧的速度非常快，同时他对于自己感兴趣的进攻技术，练习时也明显比平常的守门员训练刻苦认真得多，这令高军对他的未来更加充满信心。
一个月之后，谢文俊终于将高军昔日俱乐部队友谢风的招牌绝技“大步趟球”（这一技巧看起来十分简单，但真能用好的人其实不多，因为趟球的力度是很难把握好的。）与最基本的脚弓推射初步练熟了，这时高军便利用自己可以直接见到徐根保的机会，向其说明了此事，话说徐指导再怎么一视同仁，基地的老板成了自己的监护人之后，毕竟还是有些便利的......
徐根保在得知一个不满10周岁、百米速度就已经跑进12秒（手计时）的好苗子居然被安排当了守门员，登时气得不行，但为了避免冤枉好人，他还是特地安排了一场基地内部的训练赛，让谢文俊改踢边锋，结果谢文俊以一己之力将89年龄组的防线给冲得稀里哗啦......
要知道谢文俊不仅仅是速度快，发育较早的他在身高、弹跳与力量等方面相比同龄的小球员同样拥有压倒性的优势，89年龄组也就同样发育较早的小胖子蔡慧康能够勉强与之抗衡，但速度与灵活性却又差了好大一截，再加上高军传授的进攻技巧，所向披靡本来就是正常的，毕竟少年队中还没有什么整体防守的概念，因而一对一的优势被极度地放大了......
这场比赛才看到一半，脾气火爆的徐指导就忍不住了，当即将那个只凭身高选守门员的愚蠢教练给炒了鱿鱼，并在其后的三个月内一直留在基地里仔细观察，逐步对那些明显不适合自己所踢位置的球员进行了调整。而促成这一切的高军也由此更受徐根保的重视，不过这时的高军已经因为即使进入88年龄组后，依然因为技术意识出众而表现出色而跳级升到了基地第一期的87年龄组，而在这儿他竟然意外地见到了两位昔日弟子......
注1：由于传统习惯问题，中国妇女在孕期很少会增加蔬菜水果的摄入量，甚至反而会有所减少，而需要量却是平时的3倍，因此几乎全都严重缺乏叶酸，但脊柱骨裂等神经管畸形的衍生疾病发病率也就几分之一，可见缺乏叶酸导致胎儿神经管发育不全的概率并不是百分之百的。

Chapter 7 God opens his eyes
Forced by his father's threats, Qi Zhen had no choice but to continue practicing hurdles honestly, and eventually became the first hurdler in China. Later, in his memoirs, he thanked his father for his practice at that time. But when Gao Jun, who deeply loves Chinese football, learned about this incident, he felt very chilled by it. It is understandable for a father to consider his son's future, but an important figure in Chinese football is so stubbornly opposed to his son entering this industry. Where is the hope for Chinese football?
Precisely because he knows how difficult it is for a top hurdler to change his career to play football, Gao Jun cherishes the boy he sent to his door. Especially Xie Wenjun is in a different situation from Qi Zhen. He has just turned 10 years old and is undoubtedly much more malleable. Therefore, it is more worthy of Gao Jun to tailor a set of future career plans for him, although most of them cannot be told to him yet...
Considering that Xie Wenjun's current technical foundation is still very weak, Gao Jun did not immediately try to get him to change his position, so as not to lose interest in football due to poor performance in the frontcourt when he first entered the frontcourt. Instead, after every day's training, Xie Wenjun was specially given to accompany him for one-on-one and shooting exercises. First, Xie Wenjun served as the goalkeeper, and Gao Jun took the ball to attack, and then reversed. This way, Xie Wenjun's most basic offensive ability was slowly cultivated, and it also helped Gao Jun further get used to this new body and restore his peak skills as soon as possible.
In addition, Gao Jun also gave Xie Wenjun a special lesson, teaching Xie Wenjun a variety of simple and practical skills such as passing, getting rid of, catching, passing, crossing, and shooting. It is worth mentioning that these actions have been specially screened by Gao Jun to ensure that they will not be affected by Xie Wenjun's congenital spinal fracture in his memory, and will not induce injuries related to it.
But what Gao Jun didn't expect was that Xie Wenjun was not found to have any problems during a comprehensive physical examination at the Chongming base not long after. The lumbar fracture in his memory did not appear on Xie Wenjun in this time and space. Gao Jun was naturally even more delighted after learning about it. He couldn't help but sigh that God had opened his eyes. From then on, he continued to treat Xie Wenjun more seriously and meticulously, making his growth rate faster and faster...
In fact, spondylolysis is a very common congenital defect in China, with a proportion as high as several percent. Except for a few serious cases, the impact is not very great, as long as you are not working in a job where the fractured area will be subject to frequent violent impacts. The main cause is the lack of folic acid in the mother's body during conception and early pregnancy (it is useless to supplement after pregnancy, as there must be no lack of folic acid at the time of conception). This causes the fetal neural tube to be underdeveloped, and it is not certain to happen. There is only a fraction of the probability (note 1). Therefore, it is not surprising that some minor changes occurred in this time and space to save Xie Wenjun from this congenital disease.
Without this congenital defect, Gao Jun is almost certain that if Xie Wenjun still learns to hurdle as he did in history, the possibility of surpassing Liu Xiang is very high. But in the eyes of Gao Jun, who loves football, the value of one more hurdle king in China is far less than one more world-class star in China. This is true even for Xie Wenjun. Due to the huge influence of football, if he can really become a world-class player Star, no matter in terms of reputation or profit, he is no worse than the hurdle king. What's more, Liu Xiang's huge income is largely due to being "first". If Xie Wenjun learned hurdles, even if he surpassed him in performance, he would not be able to obtain such great fame and fortune. Therefore, no matter what, Gao Jun still insisted on cultivating Xie Wenjun into an outstanding player. After changing to an offensive position, Xie Wenjun's interest in football was quickly restored. For a young player, nothing can promote his rapid progress more than interest...
wordsIt is said that although Gao Hong seldom dribbled people in games back then, it was just because he was too slow, and it didn't mean much to pass people. But if we only talk about dribbling skills, Gao Hong, who has a high football intelligence and has worked hard since childhood, can be regarded as second-rate at least in China. The same is true for his long-range shooting and free kick abilities. He has only practiced crossing and various defensive techniques...
During the training, Gao Jun discovered that Xie Wenjun learned various skills very quickly. At the same time, he practiced the offensive skills he was interested in much harder than usual goalkeeper training. This made Gao Jun more confident in his future.
A month later, Xie Wenjun finally mastered Gao Jun's former club teammate Xie Feng's signature skill of "stride the ball" (this skill seems very simple, but there are not many people who can use it well, because the strength of the ball is difficult to master) and the most basic arch shot. At this time, Gao Jun took advantage of the opportunity to see Xu Genbao directly and explained the matter to him. After all, no matter how much Director Xu treats everyone equally, it is still somewhat convenient after the boss of the base becomes his guardian...
Xu Genbao was furious when he learned that a promising youngster who was under 10 years old and could run 100 meters under 12 seconds (hand-timed) was appointed as a goalkeeper. However, in order to avoid wronging good people, he specially arranged a training match within the base and asked Xie Wenjun to play as a winger. As a result, Xie Wenjun single-handedly overwhelmed the defense line of the 89-year-old group...
You must know that Xie Wenjun is not only fast. He also has an overwhelming advantage over young players of the same age in terms of height, jumping and strength because he developed earlier. Cai Huikang, a fat boy in the 89 age group who also developed earlier, can barely compete with him, but his speed and flexibility are far behind. Coupled with the offensive skills taught by Gao Jun, it is normal to be invincible. After all, there is no concept of overall defense in the youth team, so the one-on-one advantage is extremely amplified...
Only halfway through the game, the hot-tempered Director Xu couldn't help it anymore. He immediately fired the stupid coach who only selected the goalkeeper based on height. He stayed at the base for the next three months to observe carefully, and gradually made adjustments to the players who were obviously not suitable for the position he played. Gao Jun, who facilitated all this, received more attention from Xu Genbao. However, at this time, Gao Jun had already jumped to the 87 age group in the first phase of the base because of his outstanding technical awareness even after entering the 88 age group. And here he unexpectedly met two former disciples...
Note 1: Due to traditional habits, Chinese women rarely increase their intake of fruits and vegetables during pregnancy, or even decrease it, and the required amount is three times that of usual. Therefore, almost all of them are severely deficient in folic acid. However, the incidence of spina bifida and other neural tube malformation-derived diseases is only a fraction. It can be seen that the probability of fetal neural tube dysplasia caused by lack of folic acid is not 100%.
